title: Does adding ATH proximity as a linear-weighted composite-score factor produce a better top-3 selection?

tables.name: Top-3 outcome by ath_weight (linear blend, within existing top-50 shortlist)

notes: Tests the CAUSAL question (does boosting this signal change the top-3 selection for the better), not just the observational one (do picks that happen to be near-ATH do better). Only within the existing top-50 accumulation shortlist -- see ath_universe_calibration.py for whether ATH proximity has a real edge outside it too, which a linear blend capped within top-50 could never surface even if true.

conclusion.summary: At least one ath_weight beats the 0% baseline win rate on both splits -- worth a closer look.
